LanguageData.AIAdvisor_Welcome:
Ask anything about your colony.

Examples:
- Who is best suited to be our doctor?
- Are we ready for the next raid?
- What should we research next?
- Why is Tanya's mood so low?

Enter = send, Shift+Enter = new line.

LanguageData.AIAdvisor_LocalHelp: Start your Ollama or LM Studio server first. No key, no cost.
LanguageData.AIAdvisor_LocalModelHelp: The model must support tool calling (e.g. qwen3, llama3.1).
LanguageData.AIAdvisor_NoModel: No model selected. Choose one in settings.
LanguageData.AIAdvisor_McpHelp: Lets your own AI app (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI) read this game. No API cost.
LanguageData.AIAdvisor_McpCommands: Run your app's command once in a terminal:
LanguageData.AIAdvisor_McpUsage: Load a colony, then ask in that app. While MCP is on the game keeps running in the background, so pause it while you ask.
LanguageData.AIAdvisor_WebSearchHelp: The AI can look things up on the web (e.g. the RimWorld Wiki) when it is unsure about game mechanics, numbers or mods. Runs on Anthropic/OpenAI servers: about $0.01 per search, plus the search results count as input tokens. Not used with Gemini, OpenRouter or local models.
